_description: Maximum operations per oracle call for quantum advantage within 10^6 seconds (~2 weeks). Classical baseline: single ASIC chip (A100-equivalent). Quantum: 10,000 logical qubits, 10μs gate time, all-to-all connectivity.
_note: These are UPPER BOUNDS — actual crossover will be significantly worse because Hoefler's assumptions are optimistic for quantum and pessimistic for classical.

algorithm_speedup_mapping._description: Mapping of quantum algorithm families to their proven asymptotic speedup order. Based on established theoretical results.

hhl.caveat: Only if matrix is efficiently row-computable and full solution readout not needed

qaoa.caveat: Heuristic NISQ algorithm, no proven asymptotic speedup

vqe.caveat: Variational heuristic, no proven asymptotic speedup

quantum-annealing.caveat: Heuristic, no proven polynomial speedup over classical for general problems

quantum-ml.caveat: No proven asymptotic speedup for general ML tasks

qubo.caveat: QUBO formulation is an encoding, not an algorithm with proven speedup

hybrid.caveat: Hybrid approaches inherit speedup (or lack thereof) from the quantum subroutine used

_verdict_categories.viable: Passes all Hoefler tests — quantum advantage theoretically achievable
_verdict_categories.likely_viable: Quartic+ speedup, likely passes unless oracle is extreme
_verdict_categories.potentially_viable: Cubic speedup with oracle complexity below Table 2 threshold
_verdict_categories.cubic_conditional: Cubic speedup but oracle complexity unknown — needs investigation
_verdict_categories.quadratic_insufficient: Quadratic speedup — fails per Hoefler Table 2 (max 68 binary ops/oracle)
_verdict_categories.no_proven_speedup: No asymptotic speedup proven (NISQ heuristics like QAOA/VQE/QA)
_verdict_categories.oracle_too_complex: Cubic+ speedup but oracle exceeds maximum operations threshold
_verdict_categories.io_bottleneck: Exponential speedup but classical data loading negates advantage
_verdict_categories.insufficient_data: Not enough information to assess speedup order or oracle complexity
